name: Query a cmdId
characteristic: 1001 (reply on 1002)
responseOrNotify: Reply is a normal block for <cid> on 1002, decoded by the same bean as an unsolicited change notification
preconditions: requestSettingData only sends when the link is connected
postActions: Result stored in singleKVMap/EarphoneStatus and posted on EventBus code 106 (single value) / 35 (bool) / 108 (hex)
models: WQ/default QCY GATT (N70 path); JL (RCSP) and ZR have their own transports
notes: Used for every readable setting. The app re-queries after most writes (200 ms for 0x1D, 500 ms for 0x14, immediately for ANC/phone list). Exception: the noise strength read (0x07) is sent as the write-shaped [07 01 FF], not as FE.

name: Frame envelope
frame: FF <bodyLen> { <cmd> <paramLen> <params...> }+   bodyLen = total bytes after it; several blocks may share one frame
characteristic: 1001 write / 1002 notify+read
responseOrNotify: Notify on 1002 uses the same envelope; the app drops a notification unless length == bodyLen+2 and then iterates every block
preconditions: MTU: app asks for a larger MTU and stores mtu-3 (min 20) as the per-write limit; EQ band count is limited by (mtu-7)/6
models: WQ/default QCY GATT (N70 path); JL (RCSP) and ZR have their own transports
notes: getSendData takes several byte[] blocks and concatenates them behind FF len, so a frame can carry more than one command. A block with paramLen 0 is delivered as null data. the vendor app.the vendor app (DB:~110) picks the decoder by cmd.

name: GATT 0007 firmware version (read)
frame: 3 bytes = left a.b.c, 6 bytes = left + right
postActions: HTTP panel request keyed by vendorId + firmware
models: WQ/default QCY GATT (N70 path); JL (RCSP) and ZR have their own transports

name: GATT 0008 battery (read + notify)

name: GATT 000D key functions v2 (read, write, notify)
frame: write: raw pairs [eventId, funId]... (no FF envelope); read/notify: pairs
responseOrNotify: read via readButtonFunction; app re-reads after every key write (readKeyFunction)
preconditions: eventId 1..10 music L/R single,double,triple,four,long; 21..30 voice-call set; funId 0 none,1 play/pause,2 prev,3 next,4 assistant,5 vol+,6 vol-,7 game,8 answer,9 refuse,10 hold on,11 redial (panel may reuse 11 as ANC mode)
models: WQ/default QCY GATT (N70 path); JL (RCSP) and ZR have their own transports
notes: funId 0 on vendorIds with (id&0xF0) in {0x20,0x30,0x80} and firmware >= 1.1.0 is written as 0xFF (CM:~1533). The pair bytes come from the server panel cmd hex (ControlerPanl.FunBean.cmdBytes = [eventId, funId]).

name: Multi-band EQ v2 (7 bytes per band, with type)
frame: FF <7n+5> 22 <7n+3> <slot> <master lo> <master hi> { <f lo> <f hi> <g lo> <g hi> <q lo> <q hi> <type> }*n
characteristic: 00001001 (service A001), write; the vendor app.sendBleCmdData drops the frame silently when the link is not connected, sendBleData does not check
responseOrNotify: notify/query reply = same payload ([slot][master int16 centi-dB][bands x7])
preconditions: master gain = getMaxGain(): auto from curve peak and volumeLevel, base -10 dB (stored LAST_Base_GAIN)
postActions: saveCurrentEQParams; EventBus 70; the 0x22 echo refreshes the UI unless lastEQSend is recent
models: WQ/default QCY GATT (N70 path); JL (RCSP) and ZR have their own transports
notes: Slot byte: factory preset id 1..14 as the panel 'id'; custom curves: saveIndex 255 or 0 becomes 255 when no last-used EQ record exists and 128 (0x80) when one does (CM:~574). Unused positions are padded to the cap with freq 0, gain 0, Q 0, type 0xFF; app UI range is +-8 dB (EqViewCusomTest, panel mindb/maxdb 8). Read-back slots with (id&127)==122 are mapped to 255; ids <122 except 11 refresh the stored base gain.
status: implemented-different(app writes slot 128 when a last-used record exists; we write 255 as measured; we write 73 bytes (10 positions) when the tail is empty and the pad is 0xFF type only for slot 255)
